task: Implement the Phase 2 Python harness exactly as specified in harness/DESIGN.md (read it first, then PAD.md for constraints). Package harness/ with stream.py, situations.py, tools.py, actor.py, skills.py, advancements.py, eval.py, __main__.py. Python 3 stdlib, plus httpx only if already importable in the venv used by runner.py (check; otherwise urllib). Do NOT edit bridge.mjs or public/ or tests/*.cjs or tests/*.mjs (another worker owns them). Where DESIGN.md says 'add /v1/label to bridge if missing', instead send the label over the existing WebSocket /control as {type:'label', label:'good'|'bad'} using the `websockets` package if importable or a minimal stdlib websocket client; if neither is feasible, write labels only to harness.jsonl and note it. Bridge HTTP API (live at http://127.0.0.1:8876): GET /healthz, /v1/observation, /v1/keyframe, /v1/events/recent, /v1/stream (SSE, `data: {json}` lines), /v1/targets, /v1/encounters; POST /v1/skill {name, target_id|block}, /v1/action, /v1/stop, /v1/resume, /v1/equip, /v1/command {command:'/...'}. Event schema: {tick, t_ms, kind, ...}; kinds include self (field: correction|health|food|...), entity (field: spawn|despawn|motion|hurt; category), projectile (tti_ticks, will_hit), inventory (item, delta, count), block (at, from, to), key (key, to, src), look, damage (amount), advancement (name), label (encounter_id, action), teacher (field: ...), loadout, command, keyframe. Mock actor HARNESS_MODEL=mock must work with no API key. Include unit tests tests/test_situations.py and tests/test_skills.py per DESIGN.md Verification and make them pass with python -m pytest or python -m unittest (whichever is available). Use the pstack plugin and its skills whenever they apply. Read the matching pstack skill before acting.
context: Windows. Bridge and Minecraft server are running; do not restart or kill them (another worker may restart the bridge; if /healthz is down for a moment, wait and retry). The bot is FastBrain; the human teacher is player 6ento. No hard-coded Minecraft progression logic anywhere; skills are mined from labeled encounters in the trajectory JSONL under logs/. Latency matters (see PAD.md Constraints): SSE reader must be non-blocking with a bounded ring; observe() output under ~1500 chars.
done: python -m harness --help works; unit tests pass; `python -m harness run --turns 3` with HARNESS_MODEL=mock against the live bridge produces 3 llm entries in harness.jsonl and the bot visibly moves (position delta in /v1/observation); `python -m harness mine logs/<latest trajectory>.jsonl` runs without error (0 encounters acceptable). Report file list, test output, and the smoke-run output verbatim.
